Meet the Troll

The face that launched a thousand arguments. Elongated chin, slanted half-closed eyes, and a grin with far too many teeth — the original Trollface, now standing on two legs and dressed for trouble: orange patched hoodie, teal skull tee, patched cargo jeans, and sneakers that refuse to match.

He has moved his whole world onto Canton Network. The island above is his: portal, city, cave and all. Most of it is still under construction — trolls build slowly, mostly because they keep pranking the builders.
